title: Fine-Pitch 30 μm Cu-Cu Bonding by Using Low Temperature Microfluidic Electroless Interconnection
orgs: Advanced Semiconductor Engineering (ASE) Group (Product Characterization, Corporate R&D); National Taiwan University (Department of Materials Science and Engineering)
notes: Pressureless 50 C microfluidic electroless Cu-Cu chip-to-chip bonding of 17,600 Cu pillars (30/35/45 um pitch, 28 um standoff); 200 C N2 post-anneal; horizontal side-by-side concept.
